nodes.name: BASE_URL
nodes.docstring:
Low-level OpenRouter provisioning key API adapter (billing/openrouter.mjs).

IMPORTANT: This module is NOT authoritative customer resolution or
concurrency coordination. The caller MUST resolve the customer's
RevenueCat association and serialize create operations BEFORE invoking
createManagedKey/reconcileManagedKey. A missing existingKeyHash parameter
is NOT evidence that the customer has no key; reconcileManagedKey requires
an explicit existingKeyHash (non-empty string, or null only after the
caller has verified absence against authoritative customer/provider
records). Calling this module alone does NOT make provisioning complete.

No persistence, no hosting, no SDK dependencies. Secrets are accepted via
explicit options only, never read from or logged to the environment, and
never embedded in errors.

nodes.name: BLINK_ENDPOINT
nodes.docstring: Official Blink GraphQL adapter for USD (stablesats) Lightning invoices.Mechanical adapter only: reads configuration, reads the configured USDwallet, creates USD Lightning invoices, and reads invoice payment status.It never grants access, persists records, introduces a ledger, or treats aprovider-confirmed PAID state as an access grant. Callers must ingest a realexternal receipt into the payment authority (RevenueCat) and read back thatauthority before any access is granted.Security invariants:- The API key is server-only and never appears in results, errors, or logs.- The endpoint is fixed to the production Blink GraphQL API; no untrusted  endpoint is ever accepted from callers or the environment.- Quotes are trusted server input. Callers must authenticate the account UID  and load an immutable, persisted quote before calling. Product id and  amount are never taken from untrusted browser input.- externalId is a correlation marker only, not a documented idempotency  guarantee. Callers must enforce single-invoice-per-quote and durable  association/recovery in an approved operational store; invoice mutations  are never retried (an ambiguous creation must be reconciled, never  duplicated into a second chargeable invoice).

nodes.name: readBlinkConfig
nodes.docstring: Read and validate the Blink adapter configuration from the environment.@param {NodeJS.ProcessEnv | Record<string, string> | ((name: string) => string | undefined)} [env]  Environment source; defaults to process.env. May be an object or a getter  function.@returns {{ apiKey: string, walletId: string, network: 'mainnet', endpoint: string }}

nodes.name: readBlinkUsdWallet
nodes.docstring: Read the configured USD wallet and verify it exists exactly once on theaccount with USD currency.@param {ReturnType<typeof readBlinkConfig>} config@param {{ fetchImpl?: typeof fetch }} [options]@returns {Promise<{ walletId: string, walletCurrency: 'USD' }>}

nodes.name: createBlinkUsdInvoice
nodes.docstring: Create a USD Lightning invoice for a trusted, server-loaded quote.The quote must already be authenticated and immutable on the server; thisfunction never derives product or amount from untrusted input. Creation isnot retried: an ambiguous outcome must be reconciled by the caller insteadof issuing a second chargeable invoice. A paid state here never grantsaccess.@param {{  accountUid: string,  quoteId: string,  productId: string,  currency: 'USD',  amountMinor: number,  expiresAt: string,}} quote Trusted server-side quote.@param {ReturnType<typeof readBlinkConfig>} config@param {{ fetchImpl?: typeof fetch, now?: () => number }} [options]@returns {Promise<{  provider: 'blink', network: 'mainnet', accountUid: string, quoteId: string,  productId: string, currency: 'USD', amountMinor: number, walletId: string,  externalId: string, paymentRequest: string, paymentHash: string,  satoshis: number, createdAt: string, expiresAt: string,  state: 'paid' | 'pending' | 'expired',}>}

nodes.name: readBlinkInvoiceStatus
nodes.docstring: Read the payment status of a previously created Blink invoice from thetrusted, server-persisted record.The record must come from the caller's own durable store (never fromarbitrary browser-supplied hashes). Only the provider's status is trusted:PENDING remains pending even past expiry, and a PAID result is not an accessgrant.@param {{  provider: string, network: string, walletId: string, quoteId: string,  accountUid: string, paymentHash: string, paymentRequest: string,  amountMinor: number, currency: string, expiresAt: string,}} record Trusted server-created invoice record.@param {ReturnType<typeof readBlinkConfig>} config@param {{ fetchImpl?: typeof fetch, now?: () => number }} [options]@returns {Promise<{ quoteId: string, accountUid: string, paymentHash: string, state: 'paid' | 'pending' | 'expired', observedAt: string }>}

nodes.name: readBlinkSettlement
nodes.docstring: Read and verify the on-ledger settlement for a previously created Blinkinvoice from the trusted, server-persisted record.A paid invoice status alone is not sufficient: the actual USD wallettransaction must exist, match the recorded amount, correlation id, and aplausible settlement timestamp exactly once. A returned settlement is stillnot an access grant; callers must ingest it into the payment authority.@param {{  provider: string, network: string, walletId: string, quoteId: string,  accountUid: string, productId: string, paymentHash: string,  paymentRequest: string, externalId: string, amountMinor: number,  currency: string, createdAt: string, expiresAt: string,}} record Trusted server-created invoice record.@param {ReturnType<typeof readBlinkConfig>} config@param {{ fetchImpl?: typeof fetch, now?: () => number }} [options]@returns {Promise<{  accountUid: string, quoteId: string, productId: string,  paymentHash: string, transactionId: string, paidAt: string,  currency: 'USD', amountMinor: number,} | null>} Settlement details, or null when the invoice is not yet paid.

nodes.name: RECEIPTS_ENDPOINT
nodes.docstring: RevenueCat external purchase receipt submission adapter for Blink Lightningsettlements.Mechanical adapter only: submits an already-verified Blink settlement intoRevenueCat as an external purchase receipt. This submission is NOT a grantand NOT a readiness signal; access must only ever be granted after readingback RevenueCat as the payment authority.Security invariants:- The API key is server-only and never appears in results, errors, or logs.- The endpoint is fixed to the production RevenueCat receipts API; no  untrusted endpoint is ever accepted from callers or the environment.- The settlement must come from readBlinkSettlement on the server side;  it is never constructed from client input.- Retry safety is the caller's responsibility: reuse the exact persisted  paidAt, payment hash, and transaction id so the stable identity hashes  are idempotent. This module performs no automatic retries.

nodes.name: submitBlinkReceipt
nodes.docstring: Submit a verified Blink settlement to RevenueCat as an external purchasereceipt.The settlement must be the exact object returned by readBlinkSettlement,obtained server side. This call never grants access and never reads backentitlements; callers must read RevenueCat as the payment authority beforegranting anything. On failure, reuse the exact persisted paidAt, paymenthash, and transaction id for the retry so identity hashes stay stable.@param {{  accountUid: string, quoteId: string, productId: string,  paymentHash: string, transactionId: string, paidAt: string,  currency: 'USD', amountMinor: number,}} settlement Server-side settlement from readBlinkSettlement.@param {{ apiKey: string, sourceProductId: string }} options.config  App-specific external API key and the RevenueCat product id to report.@param {{ fetchImpl?: typeof fetch }} [options]@returns {Promise<{ submitted: true, purchaseIdentifier: string, paymentIdentifier: string }>}

nodes.name: createBlinkStore

Until the facilitatoris configured, access is honestly refused — never granted for free.
